competition_format.label: Elimination fights, then semi-finals, then live finals

phases.label: Elimination fights
phases.rule: Team challenges decided which team chose the next matchup, and the loser of each fight left the competition. Early challenges also eliminated fighters without a fight. A fighter could fight more than once, and a fighter could reach the last four without a house fight.

sources.quote: to determine which had the right to pair one of their fighters against an opponent of their choice
These challenges resulted in eliminations of fighters who hadn't fought
fighters would also leave the house for good upon losing
two fighters are eliminated and sent home

_resolved_conflicts.detail: The source lists Bobby Southworth as both a quarter-final winner (over Lodune Sincaid) and a quarter-final loser (to Stephan Bonnar) in the same round, and asserts Sam Hoger reached the semi-finals without naming a bout. The three stated bouts are recorded; the round is marked partial rather than reordered into something the source does not say.
_resolved_conflicts.resolution: Not a source conflict. Season 1 had an elimination phase, not quarter-finals: the loser of each house fight left, so a fighter could fight twice and others reached the last four without a house fight. Every bout fits that format and none is missing (see competition_format).

_resolved_conflicts.detail: Diego Sanchez is listed twice in the quarter-finals, against Alex Karalexis and against Josh Rafferty, and Kenny Florian is placed in the semi-finals without a stated bout. Recorded as given, marked partial.
